cards.title: Conflux
powers: {Conflux} deals 1 target 2 damage of a type of your choice.
incapacitatedAbilities: One player may play a card.
One player may draw a card.
Until the start of your next turn, increase all damage dealt by 1.

openingLines.default: Let us see if you can handle all I have!

cards.title: Power Crystal
body: Increase damage dealt by {Conflux} to non-hero targets by 1 for every 2 different types of damage {Conflux} has dealt this turn.

cards.title: Negabolt
body: {Conflux} deals 1 target 2 infernal damage. You may destroy an ongoing card.
Play a card now or {Conflux} deals 1 target 3 infernal damage.

cards.title: Flarebolt
body: {Conflux} deals 1 target 2 fire damage. Draw 1 card.
Play a card now or {Conflux} deals 1 target 3 fire damage.

cards.title: Snowbolt
body: {Conflux} deals 1 target 2 cold damage. {Conflux} gains 2 HP.
Play a card now or {Conflux} deals 1 target 3 cold damage.

cards.title: Lightning and Thunder
body: {Conflux} deals 1 target 3 lightning damage.
{Conflux} deals each non-Hero target 1 sonic damage.
Draw 2 cards.

cards.title: Prey and Spray
body: {Conflux} deals 1 target 3 radiant damage.
{Conflux} deals each non-Hero target 1 toxic damage.
You may use a power now.

cards.title: Echoed Blast
body: After the first time you use a power each turn, use that power again.

cards.title: Overcharged Crystal
powers: Each hero target regains 2 HP. {Conflux} deals each non-Hero target 2 energy damage. Draw 2 cards. Destroy 1 of your non-character cards.

cards.title: Intercepting Shot
body: If {Conflux} would be dealt damage by a non-Hero target, you may prevent that Damage and destroy this card.
When this card is destroyed, you may use a power.

cards.title: Eye of the Vortex
body: When this card is destroyed, you may destroy up to 3 ongoing or environment cards.

cards.title: Extra Arms
body: You may use an additional power during your power phase.

cards.title: Overwhelming Blast
body: Damage dealt by {Conflux} is irreducible.

cards.title: Gathered Vigor
body: Each Hero gains the following power:

[b]Power:[/b] This hero deals themselves 2 psychic damage. Reveal cards from the top of your deck until a Limited card is revealed. You may put this card either into your hand or into play. Shuffle the rest of the revealed cards your deck.

cards.title: Channel Essence
body: At the end of your turn, select a player for each different type of damage {Conflux} has dealt this turn. The selected players may draw a card.

promoCards.title: Team Conflux
powers: {Conflux} deals 1 target 1 energy damage. Select up to 1 target for each type of damage {Conflux} has dealt this turn. Until the start of your next turn, reduce damage dealt to those targets by 1.
incapacitatedAbilities: One player may play a card.
Select a Hero.  Until the start of your turn reduce damage dealt to that Hero by 1.
Select a damage type. Until the start of your next turn, change all damage dealt to that type.

openingLines.default: Everything around us stands against you!

promoCards.title: Chibi Conflux
powers: Draw 1 card. Discard up to 1 card for each different type of damage {Conflux} has dealt this turn. {Conflux} deals up to 2 targets X fire damage, where X = the number of cards discarded this way.
incapacitatedAbilities: One player may play a card.
One environment target deals each non-environment target 2 fire damage and themselves 10 fire damage.

openingLines.default: I bet I have more of a blast than you!
